A secure Android shell for the open-source OSIRIS intelligence platform. Map, layers, RECON, and feeds run on osirisai.live.
Upstream OSIRIS is MIT-licensed open source by SimplifAI Soul. This wrapper is an independent mobile client.
Responsible use: only point RECON / active scan tools at infrastructure you own or have written authorization to test.
Location is optional and used only to center the map on you when you request it.
